shorts.title: What REALLY Crashed at Roswell? 👽 Case #3
shorts.description:
A New Mexico rancher rode out across his ranch, and found shiny wreckage scattered all over the ground. Project Mogul's balloon trains carried microphones to listen for Soviet nuclear tests. The Air Force's reports came out in 1994 and 1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths
